action_items.text: The Industrial Designer will design the prototype of the remote control.
The User Interface Designer will design the prototype of the remote control.
The Marketing Expert will find out how much the display component costs.
The Marketing Expert will present his marketing strategy at the next meeting.

decisions.text: The group decided on the features that will be included in the final design of the prototype.
The remote will have customized wood casing.
The remote will have ergonomic sizing.
The remote will have voice recognition.
The remote will have a locator function.
The remote will have rubber buttons in a simple arrangement.
The remote will have an advanced chip.
The remote will have a battery life indicator.
The group discussed including a display on the remote.
The prototype will be designed without a display until the Marketing Expert finds out how much it would cost to add it.
The group decided to contact another company to manufacture the product that could do it cheaply yet still paid fair wages.
